verdicts.title: Fibers of tropicalization
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We use functoriality of tropicalization and the geometry of projections of subvarieties of tori to show that the fibers of the tropicalization map are dense in the Zariski topology. For subvarieties of tori over fields of generalized power series, points in each tropical fiber are obtained "constructively" using Kedlaya's transfinite version of Newton's method.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns density of fibers of the tropicalization map and constructive point-finding via Newton's method, with no mention of local ring unit groups, k-CNF formulas, or Frege proof depth.

verdicts.title: Positively Hyperbolic Varieties, Tropicalization, and Positroids
